course.subject: CS
course.label: Introduction to Computer Science
course.description: Basic concepts in computing and fundamental techniques for solving computational problems. Intended as a first course for computer science majors and others with a deep interest in computing.

course.subject: CS
course.label: Discrete Structures
course.description: Discrete mathematical structures frequently encountered in the study of Computer Science. Sets, propositions, Boolean algebra, induction, recursion, relations, functions, and graphs.

course.subject: CS
course.label: Data Structures
course.description: Data abstractions: elementary data structures (lists, stacks, queues, trees) and their implementation using an object-oriented programming language. Prerequisite: CS 125 or CS 128; CS 173.

course.subject: CS
course.label: Computer Architecture
course.description: Basic processor architecture, assembly language, memory hierarchies, and I/O organization. Prerequisite: CS 225.

course.subject: CS
course.label: Systems Programming
course.description: Introduction to systems programming. Prerequisite: CS 225 and CS 233.

course.subject: CS
course.label: Introduction to Algorithms and Models of Computation
course.description: Analysis of algorithms, major algorithmic techniques, and foundational models of computation. Prerequisite: one of CS 225 or ECE 220; CS 173.

course.subject: CS
course.label: Programming Languages and Compilers
course.description: Introduction to design and implementation of programming languages, and to the construction of translators for them. Prerequisite: CS 233 and CS 374; consent of instructor.

course.subject: CS
course.label: Artificial Intelligence
course.description: Major approaches to artificial intelligence including search, knowledge representation, and machine learning. Prerequisite: CS 225 and one of MATH 415 or CS 357 or MATH 257.

course.subject: CS
course.label: Machine Learning
course.description: Principal techniques of machine learning: linear regression, classification, kernel methods, deep learning. Prerequisite: CS 225; one of MATH 415, MATH 257; STAT 400.
